title: Google's Genie 4: Steer an AI World With Words
description:
Google DeepMind just announced Genie 4, a world model that builds a scene from a prompt, then lets you walk around in it and steer it in real time with plain language: change the weather, move the camera, add a person. It also generates the sound as it goes, from ambient noise and music to characters talking.

In this video:
- Steering a scene with text prompts
- Better physics: collisions and aerodynamics
- Genie 3 and Genie 4 side by side
- Scenes that stay consistent for up to two minutes, double Genie 3 (per TechCrunch)
- Native audio, and Gemini as the director
- Who can use it: a research preview for trusted testers now, Google AI Ultra subscribers and the Gemini API next

All demo footage and its sound are from Google DeepMind's Genie 4 announcement.

Sources:
Google DeepMind: https://deepmind.google/blog/genie-4-a-new-generation-of-world-simulation/
